assumptions: Only rows with status = 'delivered' were considered.
Rows with NULL shipped_date or NULL delivered_date were excluded.
Lead time in whole days was computed as CAST(julianday(delivered_date) - julianday(shipped_date) AS INTEGER), i.e. the difference in Julian days truncated to an integer.
sql:
SELECT
  MAX(CAST(julianday(delivered_date) - julianday(shipped_date) AS INTEGER)) AS max_days,
  COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM shipments
WHERE status = 'delivered'
  AND shipped_date IS NOT NULL
  AND delivered_date IS NOT NULL;
